## Social contract scores (draft)

| Promise | Score | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hard work pays | 3 | Anyone can build, but displaced workers are left to market forces. |
| Affordable essentials | 4 | Competition drives down the cost of goods and services. |
| Reliable safety net | 2 | Little role for collective support; those who fall behind rely on growth reaching them. |
| Responsive government | 2 | Direction is set by technologists, with regulation cast as an obstacle. |
| Time for what matters | 3 | Productivity gains are not tied to more time outside work. |
